main_measure.name: mean of forecast/10 x (coin 7-bar return - coin mean 7-bar return), non-overlapping cases
main_measure.threshold: confirm: positive with t >= 2 and supporting difference positive; reject: negative with t <= -2 and supporting difference negative

supporting_check.name: mean excess 7-bar return forecast>0 minus forecast<0 (Welch t), same sign as main

decided_by: The main measure is positive with t >= 2 and the supporting difference is positive.
reading: Non-overlapping cases are positions 0,7,14,... of each window with close[t+7] inside the window; each coin's mean 7-bar return is taken over these same cases in all its windows; cases with forecast 0 stay in the main measure (product 0) and are left out of both groups of the supporting check; the 300-case minimum counts all cases across coins.
